pattern: ならいざしらず / はいざしらず
aliases: nara iza shirazu / wa iza shirazu
purpose: Exclude a case as understandable while criticizing another.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
N + ならいざしらず / はいざしらず
It might be understandable for a child, but an adult not knowing surprised me.
Whatever was true in the past, that method cannot be used now.
A joke would be one thing, but it is a problem if you mean it.
formation: N + ならいざしらず / はいざしらず
restrictions: The first case is set aside; the second is judged differently.
mistake: It does not mean the speaker literally knows nothing about the first noun.
